ko.title: 중간선거가 가까워짐에 따라 우편 투표소송이 몇 주 만에 세 번째로 대법원으로 향하다

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: 중간선거가 70일도 채 남지 않은 상황에서, 우편 투표에 대한 새로운 연방 규정을 둘러싼 분쟁이 이번 선거철 가장 주목받는 법적 공방 중 하나로 격화되었습니다.

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: 트럼프 행정부는 하급 법원들이 해당 규정의 시행을 거듭 거부한 후, 논란이 되고 있는 미국 우정청(USPS)의 투표용지 처리 요건을 시행할 수 있도록 허가해 달라고 대법원에 세 번째로 요청했습니다.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## 새 규정이 요구하는 사항

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: 법원 제출 문서에 따르면, 논란이 된 정책은 우편 투표용지에 특정 바코드 추적 마커를 부과하고, 투표용지를 집계하기 전에 주 유권자 명부와 연계된 새로운 확인 단계를 거치도록 요구합니다.

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: 행정부 관리들은 이 조치가 투표용지 추적을 현대화하고 처리 오류의 위험을 줄이기 위한 것이라고 주장하며, 이러한 변화를 통해 선거 관리들이 투표용지의 수령 및 정확한 집계를 확인하는 더 나은 도구를 갖추게 될 것이라고 말했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## 연방 판사가 개입한 이유

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: 연방 판사는 유권자들이 투표소로 향하기 불과 몇 주 전에 이 규정의 효력을 정지시켰으며, 갑작스러운 변화가 광범위한 혼란을 일으킬 수 있다는 투표권 옹호 단체들과 여러 주 선거 관리 사무소의 우려를 인용했습니다.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: 법원 문서에 따르면, 판사는 선거에 임박하여 생소한 바코드 및 확인 요건을 도입하면 유효한 투표용지가 지연되거나 플래그가 지정되거나 거부될 수 있어, 새로운 절차에 적응할 기회가 없었던 유권자들의 투표권을 사실상 박탈할 수 있다고 경고했습니다.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: 규정에 이의를 제기하는 이들을 대리하는 변호사들은 여러 주의 선거 관리자들이 시스템을 업데이트하고, 투표소 사무원을 교육하거나, 유권자에게 통지할 충분한 시간을 제공받지 못했다고 말하며, 이 정도 규모의 변경 사항은 일반적으로 선거 주기 몇 주 전이 아니라 훨씬 전에 단계적으로 도입되어야 한다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## 대법원으로 가는 길

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: 가처분 명령이 내려진 이후, 행정부 법률팀은 이례적으로 신속한 항소 전략을 추진하여 하급 법원의 명령에 대한 효력 정지를 요청하기 위해 긴급 형식으로 세 번째 대법원에 돌아왔습니다.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: 제출 문서에서 행정부는 USPS와 주 선거 관리들이 촉박한 통보에도 해당 요건을 시행할 수 있으며, 규정 시행을 미루는 것이 투표율이 높은 중간선거 주기 동안 투표용지 처리에 대한 신뢰를 떨어뜨릴 수 있다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: 반대측은 반복되는 긴급 항소 자체가 막판 혼란의 위험을 반영하는 것이라 반박하며, 제한된 서면 심리만 이루어지는 긴급 사건 처리 제도를 통해 변경 사항을 승인하기보다는 대법원이 보다 신중한 하급 법원의 검토 과정을 계속하도록 허용해야 한다고 맞섰습니다.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: 대법원은 이번 최신 요청에 대해 언제 판결을 내릴지 아직 밝히지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: 법률 분석가들은 선거 일정이 다가옴에 따라 대법관들이 신속하게 움직일 수 있다고 지적하지만, 결과와 여러 주에서 이미 우편 투표 절차를 진행 중인 투표용지에 미칠 실질적인 영향은 여전히 불확실합니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: 여러 주의 선거 관리들은 어느 쪽 결과에든 대비한 비상 계획을 준비하고 있다고 밝혔으며, 투표권 단체들은 소송 경과를 계속해서 주의 깊게 지켜보고 있습니다.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 중간선거가 가까워짐에 따라, 이 사건은 다가오는 몇 주 동안 선거 관리자와 우편 투표에 의존하는 유권자 모두에게 계속해서 초점이 될 것으로 예상됩니다.

zh.title: 邮寄选票之争在几周内第三次诉至最高法院，中期选举临近

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: 距离中期选举还有不到 70 天，关于邮寄选票新联邦规则的争议已升级为选举季中最受关注的法律之战之一。

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: 在下级法院屡次拒绝让这些规则生效后，特朗普政府第三次请求最高法院允许有争议的美国邮政署 (USPS) 选票处理要求生效。

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## 这些规则的要求

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: 根据法庭文件，这项有争议的政策将要求在邮寄选票上贴上特定的条形码追踪标记，并在计票前实施与州选民名单挂钩的新验证步骤。

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: 政府官员辩称，这些措施旨在使选票追踪现代化并降低处理错误的风险，并表示这些变化将为选举官员提供更好的工具，以确认选票能够准确无误地收到并被统计。

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## 为什么联邦法官会介入

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: 在选民前往投票站前几周，一名联邦法官阻止了这些规则的生效，理由是投票权倡导者和几个州的选举办公室对突然的变动可能导致广泛混乱表示担忧。

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: 法庭文件显示，法官警告称，在临近选举时实施不熟悉的条形码和验证要求可能会导致有效的选票被延迟、标记或拒绝——这实际上剥夺了没有机会适应新流程的选民的投票权。

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: 代表规则反对者的律师表示，多个州的选举管理者没有获得充足的时间来更新系统、培训投票站工作人员或通知选民，他们认为任何这种规模的改动通常都应该在选举周期开始前很久就逐步实施，而不是在选举前的最后几周。

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## 通往最高法院之路

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: 自从颁布禁令以来，政府的法律团队采取了异常迅速的上诉策略，以紧急状态第三次返回最高法院，请求暂缓执行下级法院的命令。

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: 在其呈递的文件中，政府辩称 USPS 和各州选举官员能够在短时间内实施这些要求，而推迟这些规则可能会削弱人们对高投票率的中期选举周期中选票处理过程的信心。

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: 反对者反驳说，一再的紧急上诉本身就反映了最后一刻发生中断的风险，法院应该允许更加审慎的下级法院审理程序继续进行，而不是在简短简报的紧急案卷上开绿灯放行这些改动。

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: 最高法院尚未表明何时对最新的请求作出裁决。

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: 法律分析人士指出，鉴于临近的选举日程，大法官们可能会迅速采取行动，尽管裁决结果——及其对几个州已经在邮寄投票流程中的选票的实际影响——仍然不确定。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: 几个州的选举官员表示，他们正在为任何一种结果准备应急计划，而投票权团体则继续密切关注这项诉讼。

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 随着中期选举的临近，预计在未来几周内，该案仍将是选举管理者以及依赖邮寄选票的选民的关注焦点。

hi.title: मध्यावधि चुनाव नजदीक आते ही, मेल-इन मतपत्रों का विवाद हफ्तों में तीसरी बार फिर से सुप्रीम कोर्ट पहुंचा

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: मध्यावधि चुनावों में 70 से भी कम दिन बचे होने के साथ, मेल-इन मतपत्रों के लिए नए संघीय नियमों को लेकर विवाद चुनाव सीजन की सबसे बारीकी से देखी जाने वाली कानूनी लड़ाइयों में से एक में बदल गया है।

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: ट्रम्प प्रशासन ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट से तीसरी बार विवादित यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स पोस्टल सर्विस (USPS) मतपत्र-हैंडलिंग आवश्यकताओं को लागू करने की अनुमति देने का अनुरोध किया है, क्योंकि निचली अदालतों ने बार-बार इन नियमों को आगे बढ़ाने की अनुमति देने से इनकार कर दिया था।

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## नियमों के तहत क्या आवश्यक होगा

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: अदालती दस्तावेजों के अनुसार, विवादित नीति के तहत मेल-इन मतपत्रों पर कुछ बारकोडेड ट्रैकिंग मार्करों की आवश्यकता होगी और मतपत्रों की गिनती से पहले राज्य की मतदाता सूचियों से जुड़े नए सत्यापन कदम लागू करने होंगे।

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: प्रशासन के अधिकारियों ने तर्क दिया है कि इन उपायों का उद्देश्य मतपत्र ट्रैकिंग को आधुनिक बनाना और प्रसंस्करण त्रुटियों के जोखिम को कम करना है, और कहा कि इन बदलावों से चुनाव अधिकारियों को यह पुष्टि करने के लिए बेहतर उपकरण मिलेंगे कि मतपत्र प्राप्त हो गए हैं और उनकी सटीक गिनती की गई है।

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## एक संघीय न्यायाधीश ने हस्तक्षेप क्यों किया

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: मतदाताओं के मतदान केंद्रों पर जाने से कुछ ही हफ्ते पहले एक संघीय न्यायाधीश ने नियमों को लागू होने से रोक दिया, जिसमें मतदान अधिकार कार्यकर्ताओं और कई राज्य चुनाव कार्यालयों द्वारा उठाई गई चिंताओं का हवाला दिया गया कि अचानक किए गए बदलावों से व्यापक भ्रम पैदा हो सकता है।

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: अदालती दस्तावेजों से संकेत मिलता है कि न्यायाधीश ने चेतावनी दी थी कि चुनाव के इतने करीब अपरिचित बारकोड और सत्यापन आवश्यकताओं को लागू करने से वैध मतपत्रों में देरी हो सकती है, उन्हें चिह्नित किया जा सकता है, या खारिज किया जा सकता है — जिससे उन मतदाताओं को प्रभावी रूप से मताधिकार से वंचित होना पड़ेगा जिन्हें नई प्रक्रिया के अनुकूल होने का कोई अवसर नहीं मिला।

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: नियमों को चुनौती देने वालों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले वकीलों ने कहा है कि कई राज्यों में चुनाव प्रशासकों को प्रणालियों को अपडेट करने, मतदान कर्मियों को प्रशिक्षित करने, या मतदाताओं को सूचित करने के लिए पर्याप्त समय नहीं दिया गया था, और तर्क दिया कि इस पैमाने के किसी भी बदलाव को आम तौर पर चुनाव चक्र शुरू होने से काफी पहले चरणबद्ध तरीके से लागू किया जाना चाहिए, न कि इसके अंतिम हफ्तों में।

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## सुप्रीम कोर्ट का रास्ता

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: जब से निषेधाज्ञा जारी की गई है, प्रशासन की कानूनी टीम ने असामान्य रूप से त्वरित अपील रणनीति अपनाई है, और निचली अदालत के आदेश पर रोक लगाने का अनुरोध करने के लिए तीसरी बार आपातकालीन आधार पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट का रुख किया है।

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: अपनी याचिकाओं में, प्रशासन ने तर्क दिया है कि USPS और राज्य के चुनाव अधिकारी कम समय के नोटिस पर आवश्यकताओं को लागू कर सकते हैं और नियमों में देरी करने से उच्च-मतदान वाले मध्यावधि चक्र के दौरान मतपत्र प्रसंस्करण में विश्वास कमजोर हो सकता है।

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: विरोधियों का तर्क है कि बार-बार की जाने वाली आपातकालीन अपीलें खुद अंतिम समय में व्यवधान के जोखिम को दर्शाती हैं, और कोर्ट को सीमित ब्रीफिंग वाले आपातकालीन डॉकेट पर बदलावों को हरी झंडी देने के बजाय अधिक विचारशील निचली अदालत की समीक्षा प्रक्रिया को जारी रखने की अनुमति देनी चाहिए।

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अभी तक यह संकेत नहीं दिया है कि वह नवीनतम अनुरोध पर कब फैसला सुनाएगा।

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: कानूनी विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि आगामी चुनाव कैलेंडर को देखते हुए न्यायाधीश तेजी से कार्रवाई कर सकते हैं, हालांकि इसका परिणाम — और कई राज्यों में पहले से ही मेल-इन प्रक्रिया में शामिल मतपत्रों पर इसका व्यावहारिक प्रभाव — अनिश्चित बना हुआ है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: कई राज्यों के चुनाव अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि वे दोनों में से किसी भी परिणाम के लिए आकस्मिक योजनाएं तैयार कर रहे हैं, जबकि मतदान अधिकार समूह मुकदमेबाजी पर बारीकी से नजर रखना जारी रखे हुए हैं।

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: मध्यावधि चुनाव नजदीक आने के साथ, आने वाले हफ्तों में मेल-इन मतपत्रों पर भरोसा करने वाले चुनाव प्रशासकों और मतदाताओं दोनों के लिए यह मामला ध्यान का केंद्र बने रहने की उम्मीद है।

es.title: La batalla por el voto por correo vuelve a la Corte Suprema, por tercera vez en semanas, a medida que se acercan las elecciones de medio mandato

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: A menos de 70 días para las elecciones de medio mandato, una disputa sobre las nuevas normas federales para las papeletas de voto por correo se ha convertido en una de las batallas legales más observadas de la temporada electoral.

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: La administración Trump ha solicitado a la Corte Suprema por tercera vez que permita la entrada en vigor de los requisitos impugnados del Servicio Postal de los Estados Unidos (USPS) para el manejo de papeletas, después de que tribunales inferiores se negaran repetidamente a permitir que las normas siguieran adelante.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## Qué exigirían las normas

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: Según los documentos judiciales, la política en disputa requeriría ciertos marcadores de seguimiento con código de barras en las papeletas de voto por correo e impondría nuevos pasos de verificación vinculados a las listas de votantes estatales antes de que las papeletas pudieran ser contadas.

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la administración han argumentado que las medidas tienen la intención de modernizar el seguimiento de las papeletas y reducir el riesgo de errores de procesamiento, diciendo que los cambios darían a los funcionarios electorales mejores herramientas para confirmar que las papeletas se reciban y cuenten con precisión.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## Por qué intervino un juez federal

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: Un juez federal bloqueó la entrada en vigor de las normas pocas semanas antes de que los votantes acudieran a las urnas, citando las preocupaciones planteadas por defensores de los derechos de voto y varias oficinas electorales estatales de que los cambios abruptos podrían causar una confusión generalizada.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: Los documentos judiciales indican que el juez advirtió que implementar requisitos desconocidos de códigos de barras y verificación tan cerca de una elección podría resultar en que papeletas válidas fueran retrasadas, marcadas o rechazadas, privando efectivamente del derecho al voto a ciudadanos que no tuvieron oportunidad de adaptarse al nuevo proceso.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: Los abogados que representan a los impugnadores de las normas han dicho que los administradores electorales en múltiples estados no recibieron tiempo suficiente para actualizar los sistemas, capacitar a los trabajadores electorales o notificar a los votantes, argumentando que cualquier cambio de esta magnitud debería implementarse gradualmente mucho antes de que comience un ciclo electoral, no en las últimas semanas previas al mismo.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## El camino hacia la Corte Suprema

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: Desde que se emitió la orden judicial, el equipo legal de la administración ha seguido una estrategia de apelación inusualmente rápida, regresando a la Corte Suprema de forma urgente por tercera vez para solicitar una suspensión de la orden del tribunal inferior.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: En sus presentaciones, la administración ha argumentado que el USPS y los funcionarios electorales estatales pueden implementar los requisitos con poca antelación y que retrasar las normas podría socavar la confianza en el procesamiento de las papeletas durante un ciclo de elecciones de medio mandato con alta participación.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: Los opositores responden que las repetidas apelaciones de emergencia reflejan por sí mismas el riesgo de una interrupción de último minuto, y que la Corte debería permitir que continúe el proceso de revisión más deliberado del tribunal inferior en lugar de dar luz verde a cambios en una lista de casos de emergencia con información limitada.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: La Corte Suprema aún no ha indicado cuándo se pronunciará sobre la última solicitud.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Los analistas legales señalan que los jueces podrían actuar rápidamente dado el calendario electoral que se aproxima, aunque el resultado —y su efecto práctico en las papeletas que ya están en el proceso de correo en varios estados— sigue siendo incierto.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede después

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios electorales en varios estados han dicho que están preparando planes de contingencia para cualquiera de los resultados, mientras que los grupos de derechos de voto continúan monitoreando el litigio de cerca.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: Con la proximidad de las elecciones de medio mandato, se espera que el caso siga siendo un punto central tanto para los administradores electorales como para los votantes que dependen del voto por correo en las próximas semanas.

ar.title: معركة بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد تعود إلى المحكمة العليا، للمرة الثالثة في غضون أسابيع، مع اقتراب انتخابات التجديد النصفي

segments.tr: مع تبقي أقل من 70 يوماً على انتخابات التجديد النصفي، تصاعد نزاع حول قواعد فيدرالية جديدة لبطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد ليصبح واحداً من أكثر المعارك القانونية التي تحظى بمتابعة دقيقة في موسم الانتخابات.

segments.tr: طلبت إدارة ترامب من المحكمة العليا للمرة الثالثة السماح بدخول متطلبات خدمة بريد الولايات المتحدة (USPS) المتنازع عليها بشأن التعامل مع بطاقات الاقتراع حيز التنفيذ، بعد أن رفضت المحاكم الأدنى مراراً السماح بالمضي قدماً في هذه القواعد.

segments.tr: وفقاً لملفات المحكمة، ستتطلب السياسة المتنازع عليها علامات تتبع مشفرة (بار كود) معينة على بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد، وستفرض خطوات تحقق جديدة مرتبطة بقوائم الناخبين في الولايات قبل أن يمكن فرز الأصوات.

segments.tr: جادل مسؤولو الإدارة بأن الإجراءات تهدف إلى تحديث تتبع بطاقات الاقتراع وتقليل مخاطر أخطاء المعالجة، قائلين إن التغييرات ستمنح مسؤولي الانتخابات أدوات أفضل للتأكد من استلام بطاقات الاقتراع وفرزها بدقة.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## لماذا تدخل قاضٍ فيدرالي

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: منع قاضٍ فيدرالي القواعد من دخول حيز التنفيذ قبل أسابيع فقط من توجه الناخبين إلى صناديق الاقتراع، مستشهداً بمخاوف أثارها المدافعون عن حقوق التصويت والعديد من مكاتب الانتخابات في الولايات من أن التغييرات المفاجئة قد تسبب ارتباكاً واسع النطاق.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: تشير وثائق المحكمة إلى أن القاضي حذر من أن تنفيذ متطلبات الباركود والتحقق غير المألوفة في وقت قريب جداً من الانتخابات قد يؤدي إلى تأخير بطاقات الاقتراع الصحيحة، أو وضع علامات عليها، أو رفضها - مما يحرم الناخبين فعلياً من حقهم الذين لم تكن لديهم فرصة للتكيف مع العملية الجديدة.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: قال المحامون الذين يمثلون المعارضين للقواعد إن مسؤولي الانتخابات في ولايات متعددة لم يُمنحوا وقتاً كافياً لتحديث الأنظمة، أو تدريب عمال الاقتراع، أو إخطار الناخبين، مجادلين بأن أي تغييرات بهذا الحجم يجب أن يتم تنفيذها تدريجياً قبل فترة طويلة من بدء الدورة الانتخابية، وليس في الأسابيع الأخيرة التي تسبقها.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## الطريق إلى المحكمة العليا

segments.tr: منذ صدور الأمر القضائي، اتبع الفريق القانوني للإدارة استراتيجية استئناف سريعة بشكل غير عادي، حيث عاد إلى المحكمة العليا على أساس طارئ للمرة الثالثة لطلب وقف أمر المحكمة الأدنى.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: في ملفاتها، جادلت الإدارة بأن خدمة بريد الولايات المتحدة (USPS) ومسؤولي الانتخابات في الولايات يمكنهم تنفيذ المتطلبات في وقت قصير، وأن تأخير القواعد قد يقوض الثقة في معالجة بطاقات الاقتراع خلال دورة التجديد النصفي ذات الإقبال المرتفع.

segments.tr: يرد المعارضون بأن الاستئنافات الطارئة المتكررة تعكس في حد ذاتها خطر حدوث اضطراب في اللحظة الأخيرة، وأنه يجب على المحكمة السماح لعملية المراجعة الأكثر تأنياً في المحاكم الأدنى بالاستمرار بدلاً من إعطاء الضوء الأخضر للتغييرات في جدول أعمال طارئ مع إحاطة محدودة.

segments.tr: يشير المحللون القانونيون إلى أن القضاة قد يتحركون بسرعة نظراً لتقويم الانتخابات القريب، على الرغم من أن النتيجة - وتأثيرها العملي على بطاقات الاقتراع الموجودة بالفعل في عملية البريد في عدة ولايات - لا تزال غير مؤكدة.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.tr: L'administration Trump a demandé à la Cour suprême pour la troisième fois d'autoriser l'entrée en vigueur des exigences contestées du service postal des États-Unis (USPS) concernant le traitement des bulletins de vote, après que les tribunaux inférieurs ont refusé à plusieurs reprises de laisser ces règles s'appliquer.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## Ce que les règles exigeraient

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi un juge fédéral est intervenu

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: Un juge fédéral a empêché l'entrée en vigueur de ces règles quelques semaines seulement avant que les électeurs ne se rendent aux urnes, citant les préoccupations soulevées par les défenseurs du droit de vote et plusieurs bureaux électoraux d'État selon lesquelles ces changements soudains pourraient provoquer une confusion généralisée.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: Les documents judiciaires indiquent que le juge a averti que la mise en œuvre d'exigences de codes-barres et de vérification inconnues si près d'une élection pourrait entraîner le retard, le signalement ou le rejet de bulletins valides, privant ainsi de fait les électeurs qui n'ont eu aucune possibilité de s'adapter au nouveau processus.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: Les avocats représentant les opposants aux règles ont déclaré que les administrateurs électoraux de plusieurs États n'avaient pas eu suffisamment de temps pour mettre à jour les systèmes, former les travailleurs électoraux ou informer les électeurs, arguant que tout changement de cette ampleur devrait normalement être introduit progressivement bien avant le début d'un cycle électoral, et non dans les dernières semaines qui le précèdent.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Le chemin vers la Cour suprême

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: Depuis que l'injonction a été émise, l'équipe juridique de l'administration a poursuivi une stratégie d'appel inhabituellement rapide, revenant devant la Cour suprême en urgence pour la troisième fois afin de demander une suspension de l'ordonnance du tribunal inférieur.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Dans ses documents, l'administration a fait valoir que l'USPS et les responsables électoraux des États peuvent mettre en œuvre les exigences dans un court délai et que retarder les règles pourrait miner la confiance dans le traitement des bulletins de vote pendant un cycle de mi-mandat à forte participation.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: Les opposants rétorquent que les appels d'urgence répétés reflètent eux-mêmes le risque de perturbation de dernière minute, et que la Cour devrait permettre au processus d'examen plus délibéré des tribunaux inférieurs de se poursuivre plutôt que de donner le feu vert à des changements sur un dossier d'urgence avec des mémoires limités.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: La Cour suprême n'a pas encore indiqué quand elle statuera sur la dernière demande.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Les analystes juridiques notent que les juges pourraient agir rapidement étant donné le calendrier électoral qui approche, bien que l'issue — et son effet pratique sur les bulletins déjà dans le processus de vote par correspondance dans plusieurs États — reste incertaine.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qui se passe ensuite

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: Les responsables électoraux de plusieurs États ont déclaré qu'ils préparaient des plans d'urgence pour l'une ou l'autre issue, tandis que les groupes de défense du droit de vote continuent de surveiller de près le litige.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: À l'approche des élections de mi-mandat, l'affaire devrait rester un point central tant pour les administrateurs électoraux que pour les électeurs dépendant du vote par correspondance dans les semaines à venir.

pt.title: Disputa sobre Voto por Correio Volta à Suprema Corte, a Terceira Vez em Semanas, com a Aproximação das Eleições de Meio de Mandato

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: Com menos de 70 dias restantes para as eleições de meio de mandato, uma disputa sobre novas regras federais para votos por correio escalou para uma das batalhas jurídicas mais observadas da temporada eleitoral.

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: O governo Trump pediu à Suprema Corte pela terceira vez que permita a entrada em vigor de requisitos contestados do Serviço Postal dos Estados Unidos (USPS) para o manuseio de cédulas, depois que tribunais inferiores se recusaram repetidamente a permitir o prosseguimento das regras.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## O que as Regras Exigiriam

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: De acordo com documentos judiciais, a política contestada exigiria certos marcadores de rastreamento com código de barras em cédulas enviadas por correio e imporia novas etapas de verificação vinculadas às listas estaduais de eleitores antes que as cédulas pudessem ser contadas.

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: Autoridades do governo argumentaram que as medidas visam modernizar o rastreamento de cédulas e reduzir o risco de erros de processamento, dizendo que as mudanças dariam aos funcionários eleitorais melhores ferramentas para confirmar que as cédulas sejam recebidas e contadas com precisão.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## Por que um Juiz Federal Interveio

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: Um juiz federal impediu a entrada em vigor das regras poucas semanas antes de os eleitores irem às urnas, citando preocupações levantadas por defensores do direito ao voto e vários escritórios eleitorais estaduais de que as mudanças abruptas poderiam causar confusão generalizada.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: Documentos judiciais indicam que o juiz alertou que implementar requisitos desconhecidos de código de barras e verificação tão perto de uma eleição poderia resultar em cédulas válidas sendo atrasadas, sinalizadas ou rejeitadas — efetivamente privando do direito ao voto eleitores que não tiveram oportunidade de se ajustar ao novo processo.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: Advogados que representam os opositores das regras disseram que os administradores eleitorais em vários estados não tiveram tempo adequado para atualizar sistemas, treinar mesários ou notificar os eleitores, argumentando que quaisquer mudanças dessa escala deveriam normalmente ser implementadas gradualmente bem antes do início de um ciclo eleitoral, não nas semanas finais que o antecedem.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## O Caminho para a Suprema Corte

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: Desde que a liminar foi emitida, a equipe jurídica do governo buscou uma estratégia de apelação incomumente rápida, retornando à Suprema Corte em caráter de emergência pela terceira vez para solicitar a suspensão da ordem do tribunal inferior.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Em suas petições, o governo argumentou que o USPS e os funcionários eleitorais estaduais podem implementar os requisitos com pouco aviso prévio e que atrasar as regras poderia minar a confiança no processamento de cédulas durante um ciclo de meio de mandato de alta participação.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: Os opositores contra-argumentam que as repetidas apelações de emergência refletem, por si só, o risco de interrupção de última hora, e que a Corte deveria permitir que o processo de revisão mais deliberado do tribunal inferior continue em vez de autorizar mudanças em um cronograma de emergência com briefings limitados.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: A Suprema Corte ainda não indicou quando decidirá sobre o pedido mais recente.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Analistas jurídicos observam que os juízes podem agir rapidamente dado o calendário eleitoral que se aproxima, embora o resultado — e seu efeito prático nas cédulas já no processo de envio por correio em vários estados — permaneça incerto.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: Funcionários eleitorais em vários estados disseram que estão preparando planos de contingência para qualquer um dos resultados, enquanto grupos de direitos de voto continuam a monitorar o litígio de perto.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: Com a aproximação das eleições de meio de mandato, espera-se que o caso continue sendo um ponto focal tanto para administradores eleitorais quanto para eleitores que dependem do voto por correio nas próximas semanas.

in.title: Perdebatan Surat Suara Pos Kembali ke Mahkamah Agung, Ketiga Kalinya dalam Hitungan Minggu, Menjelang Pemilu Paruh Waktu

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: Dengan waktu kurang dari 70 hari menjelang pemilihan paruh waktu, sengketa mengenai aturan federal baru untuk surat suara pos telah meningkat menjadi salah satu pertempuran hukum yang paling diawasi ketat pada musim pemilu ini.

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: Pemerintahan Trump telah meminta Mahkamah Agung untuk ketiga kalinya agar mengizinkan persyaratan penanganan surat suara United States Postal Service (USPS) yang dipersengketakan untuk diberlakukan, setelah pengadilan lebih rendah berulang kali menolak untuk membiarkan aturan tersebut dilanjutkan.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Diwajibkan oleh Aturan Tersebut

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: Menurut dokumen pengadilan, kebijakan yang dipersengketakan tersebut akan mewajibkan penanda pelacakan barcode tertentu pada surat suara pos dan memberlakukan langkah-langkah verifikasi baru yang terikat dengan daftar pemilih negara bagian sebelum surat suara dapat dihitung.

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: Para pejabat pemerintahan berargumen bahwa langkah-langkah tersebut dimaksudkan untuk memodernisasi pelacakan surat suara dan mengurangi risiko kesalahan pemrosesan, dengan mengatakan bahwa perubahan tersebut akan memberi para pejabat pemilu alat yang lebih baik untuk memastikan bahwa surat suara diterima dan dihitung secara akurat.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Hakim Federal Turun Tangan

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: Seorang hakim federal memblokir aturan tersebut agar tidak berlaku hanya beberapa minggu sebelum pemilih pergi ke tempat pemungutan suara, dengan alasan kekhawatiran yang diajukan oleh para pendukung hak suara dan beberapa kantor pemilihan negara bagian bahwa perubahan mendadak tersebut dapat menyebabkan kebingungan yang meluas.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: Dokumen pengadilan menunjukkan bahwa hakim memperingatkan bahwa penerapan persyaratan barcode dan verifikasi yang tidak familiar begitu dekat dengan pemilu dapat mengakibatkan surat suara yang sah tertunda, ditandai, atau ditolak — yang secara efektif mencabut hak pilih para pemilih yang tidak memiliki kesempatan untuk beradaptasi dengan proses baru tersebut.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: Para pengacara yang mewakili para penentang aturan tersebut mengatakan bahwa administrator pemilu di beberapa negara bagian tidak diberi waktu yang cukup untuk memperbarui sistem, melatih petugas pemungutan suara, atau memberi tahu pemilih, dengan berargumen bahwa perubahan apa pun dalam skala ini biasanya harus diterapkan secara bertahap jauh sebelum siklus pemilu dimulai, bukan pada minggu-minggu terakhir sebelum pemilu.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Jalan Menuju Mahkamah Agung

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: Sejak putusan sela dikeluarkan, tim hukum pemerintah telah menjalankan strategi banding yang luar biasa cepat, kembali ke Mahkamah Agung atas dasar darurat untuk ketiga kalinya guna meminta penundaan putusan pengadilan yang lebih rendah.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Dalam berkas perkaranya, pemerintah berargumen bahwa USPS dan pejabat pemilu negara bagian dapat menerapkan persyaratan tersebut dalam waktu singkat dan menunda aturan tersebut dapat merusak kepercayaan pada pemrosesan surat suara selama siklus paruh waktu dengan tingkat partisipasi tinggi.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: Para penentang berargumen sebaliknya bahwa banding darurat yang berulang kali diajukan sendiri mencerminkan risiko gangguan di menit-menit akhir, dan bahwa Mahkamah Agung harus membiarkan proses peninjauan pengadilan tingkat rendah yang lebih hati-hati untuk dilanjutkan daripada memberikan lampu hijau pada perubahan dalam daftar darurat dengan ringkasan yang terbatas.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: Mahkamah Agung belum mengindikasikan kapan akan mengeluarkan putusan atas permintaan terbaru tersebut.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Analis hukum mencatat bahwa para hakim dapat bertindak cepat mengingat kalender pemilu yang semakin dekat, meskipun hasilnya — dan efek praktisnya pada surat suara yang sudah dalam proses pengiriman pos di beberapa negara bagian — masih belum pasti.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: Para pejabat pemilu di beberapa negara bagian mengatakan bahwa mereka sedang mempersiapkan rencana darurat untuk salah satu kemungkinan hasil, sementara kelompok hak pilih terus memantau litigasi tersebut dengan cermat.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: Menjelang pemilu paruh waktu, kasus ini diperkirakan akan tetap menjadi pusat perhatian bagi para administrator pemilu maupun pemilih yang mengandalkan surat suara pos dalam beberapa minggu mendatang.

ja.title: 郵便投票の争いが最高裁に差し戻し、中間選挙が近づく中、数週間で3度目

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: 中間選挙まで70日を切る中、郵便投票に関する新しい連邦規則を巡る争いは、選挙戦で最も注目される法廷闘争の一つに発展している。

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: 下級審が規則の施行を繰り返し見送ったことを受け、トランプ政権は、係争中の米国の郵便公社（USPS）の投票用紙の取り扱い要件の施行を認めるよう、最高裁に3度目の要請を行った。

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## 規則の内容

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: 裁判所の提出書類によると、係争中の政策は、郵便投票用紙に特定のバーコード付き追跡マーカーを義務付け、投票用紙が集計される前に州の有権者名簿に紐づく新しい検証ステップを課すものである。

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: 政権当局者は、この措置は投票用紙の追跡を近代化し、処理エラーのリスクを軽減することを目的としていると主張しており、この変更により選挙管理官は投票用紙が正確に受領され集計されたことを確認するためのより良いツールを得ることができるとしている。

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## 連邦判事が介入した理由

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: 有権者が投票所に向かう数週間前、連邦判事は、投票権擁護団体や複数の州の選挙管理事務所から、突然の変更が広範囲にわたる混乱を引き起こす可能性があるという懸念が示されたことを引き合いに出し、規則の施行を差し止めた。

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: 裁判所の文書によると、判事は、選挙間近に不慣れなバーコードおよび検証要件を導入すると、有効な投票用紙が遅延、フラグ付け、または拒否される結果につながり、新しいプロセスに適応する機会のなかった有権者の権利を実質的に剥奪することになると警告したことが示されている。

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: 規則の異議申し立て人を代表する弁護士らは、複数州の選挙管理者がシステムを更新し、投票所の作業員を訓練し、有権者に通知するための十分な時間を与えられていないと述べ、この規模の変更は通常、選挙サイクルの最後の数週間ではなく、開始のかなり前に段階的に導入されるべきであると主張している。

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## 最高裁への道のり

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: 差し止め命令が出て以来、政権側の法務チームは異例の迅速な控訴戦略を追求しており、下級審の命令の執行停止を要請するため、異例の緊急措置として3度目の最高裁への差し戻しを行っている。

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: 提出書類の中で、政権側はUSPSと州の選挙管理官が短期間で要件を実装できること、そして規則の延期が投票率の高い中間選挙サイクル中の投票用紙処理への信頼を損なう可能性があると主張している。

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: 反対派は、度重なる緊急控訴自体が直前の混乱のリスクを反映していると反論しており、限られた準備書面による緊急の裁判日程で変更にゴーサインを出すのではなく、より慎重な下級審の審査プロセスを継続させるべきであると主張している。

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: 最高裁は、最新の要請についていつ裁定を下すかまだ示していない。

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: 法制アナリストは、接近する選挙カレンダーを考慮して判事らが迅速に行動する可能性があると指摘しているが、その結果、そしてすでに複数の州で郵便投票プロセスにある投票用紙への実際の効果は依然として不透明である。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起こるか

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: 複数の州の選挙管理官は、どちらの結果にも備えて緊急時対応計画を準備していると述べる一方、投票権団体は引き続き訴訟を注視している。

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 中間選挙が近づくにつれ、この訴訟は、今後数週間にわたり、選挙管理関係者と郵便投票に依存する有権者の双方にとっての中心的な焦点であり続けると予想される。

de.title: Kampf um Briefwahl geht vor die Zwischenwahlen zum dritten Mal in wenigen Wochen an den Obersten Gerichtshof

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: Mit weniger als 70 verbleibenden Tagen bis zu den Kongresszwischenwahlen hat sich ein Streit über neue Bundesvorschriften für Briefwahlzettel zu einem der am genauesten beobachteten Rechtskämpfe der Wahlsaison ausgeweitet.

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: Die Trump-Regierung hat den Obersten Gerichtshof zum dritten Mal gebeten, das Inkrafttreten umstrittener Anforderungen des US-Postdienstes (USPS) für die Handhabung von Stimmzetteln zuzulassen, nachdem untergeordnete Gerichte wiederholt abgelehnt hatten, die Regeln in Kraft treten zu lassen.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## Was die Regeln vorschreiben würden

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: Gerichtsakten zufolge würde die umstrittene Richtlinie bestimmte mit Strichcodes versehene Nachverfolgungskennzeichnungen auf Briefwahlzettel erfordern und neue Verifizierungsschritte auferlegen, die an staatliche Wählerlisten gekoppelt sind, bevor Stimmzettel ausgezählt werden können.

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: Regierungsbeamte haben argumentiert, dass die Maßnahmen darauf abzielen, die Stimmzettelverfolgung zu modernisieren und das Risiko von Verarbeitungsfehlern zu verringern, und sagten, die Änderungen würden Wahlbeamten bessere Werkzeuge an die Hand geben, um zu bestätigen, dass Stimmzettel eingehen und korrekt gezählt werden.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## Warum ein Bundesrichter eingriff

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: Ein Bundesrichter blockierte das Inkrafttreten der Regeln nur wenige Wochen, bevor die Wähler zu den Urnen gehen, unter Berufung auf Bedenken, die von Befürwortern des Wahlrechts und mehreren staatlichen Wahlämtern geäußert wurden, dass die abrupten Änderungen zu weitreichender Verwirrung führen könnten.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: Gerichtsdokumente deuten darauf hin, dass der Richter warnte, die Umsetzung ungewohnter Strichcode- und Verifizierungsanforderungen so kurz vor einer Wahl könnte dazu führen, dass gültige Stimmzettel verzögert, markiert oder abgelehnt werden – wodurch Wähler effektiv ihrer Stimme beraubt würden, die keine Gelegenheit hatten, sich an den neuen Prozess anzupassen.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: Anwälte, die die Gegner der Regeln vertreten, haben erklärt, dass Wahladministratoren in mehreren Bundesstaaten nicht genügend Zeit erhalten haben, Systeme zu aktualisieren, Wahlhelfer zu schulen oder Wähler zu benachrichtigen, und argumentierten, dass Änderungen dieses Ausmaßes typischerweise lange vor Beginn eines Wahlzyklus eingeführt werden sollten und nicht in den letzten Wochen davor.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Der Weg zum Obersten Gerichtshof

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: Seit Erlass der einstweiligen Verfügung hat das Anwaltsteam der Regierung eine ungewöhnlich schnelle Berufungsstrategie verfolgt und sich in einem Eilverfahren zum dritten Mal an den Obersten Gerichtshof gewandt, um die Aussetzung der Entscheidung des untergeordneten Gerichts zu beantragen.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: In ihren Eingaben hat die Regierung argumentiert, dass USPS und staatliche Wahlbeamte die Anforderungen kurzfristig umsetzen können und dass eine Verzögerung der Regeln das Vertrauen in die Verarbeitung von Stimmzetteln während eines stark frequentierten Zwischenwahlzyklus untergraben könnte.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: Gegner halten dagegen, dass die wiederholten Eilberufungen selbst das Risiko einer Störung in letzter Minute widerspiegeln und dass das Gericht die sorgfältigere Überprüfung durch die untereren Instanzen fortsetzen lassen sollte, anstatt Änderungen auf einer Eil-Dockets mit begrenzten Schriftsätzen grünes Licht zu geben.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: Der Oberste Gerichtshof hat noch nicht bekannt gegeben, wann er über den jüngsten Antrag entscheiden wird.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Rechtsanalysten merken an, dass die Richter angesichts des näher rückenden Wahlkalenders schnell handeln könnten, obwohl der Ausgang – und seine praktische Auswirkung auf Stimmzettel, die sich in mehreren Bundesstaaten bereits im Briefwahlverfahren befinden – ungewiss bleibt.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes geschieht

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: Wahlbeamte in mehreren Bundesstaaten haben erklärt, dass sie Notfallpläne für beide Ausgänge vorbereiten, während Gruppen für Bürgerrechte das Verfahren weiterhin genau beobachten.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: Da die Zwischenwahlen näher rücken, wird erwartet, dass der Fall in den kommenden Wochen ein Brennpunkt sowohl für Wahlverwalter als auch für Wähler bleiben wird, die auf Briefwahlzettel angewiesen sind.

vi.title: Cuộc chiến về phiếu bầu qua thư lại quay trở lại Tối cao Pháp viện lần thứ ba trong vài tuần khi cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ cận kề

segments.src: With fewer than 70 days remaining before the midterm elections, a dispute over new federal rules for mail-in ballots has escalated into one of the most closely watched legal battles of the election season.
segments.tr: Với chưa đầy 70 ngày còn lại trước cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ, tranh chấp về các quy định liên bang mới đối với phiếu bầu qua thư đã leo thang thành một trong những cuộc chiến pháp lý được theo dõi sát sao nhất trong mùa bầu cử này.

segments.src: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court for a third time to allow contested United States Postal Service (USPS) ballot-handling requirements to take effect, after lower courts repeatedly declined to let the rules proceed.
segments.tr: Chính quyền Trump đã yêu cầu Tối cao Pháp viện lần thứ ba cho phép các yêu cầu xử lý phiếu bầu gây tranh cãi của Dịch vụ Bưu điện Hoa Kỳ (USPS) có hiệu lực, sau khi các tòa án cấp dưới liên tục từ chối cho phép các quy định này được tiến hành.

segments.src: ## What the Rules Would Require
segments.tr: ## Các quy định này sẽ yêu cầu những gì

segments.src: According to court filings, the disputed policy would require certain barcoded tracking markers on mail-in ballots and impose new verification steps tied to state voter lists before ballots could be counted.
segments.tr: Theo các hồ sơ tòa án, chính sách gây tranh cãi này sẽ yêu cầu các dấu hiệu theo dõi bằng mã vạch nhất định trên phiếu bầu qua thư và áp dụng các bước xác minh mới liên kết với danh sách cử tri của bang trước khi phiếu bầu có thể được kiểm đếm.

segments.src: Administration officials have argued the measures are intended to modernize ballot tracking and reduce the risk of processing errors, saying the changes would give election officials better tools to confirm that ballots are received and counted accurately.
segments.tr: Các quan chức chính quyền lập luận rằng các biện pháp này nhằm hiện đại hóa việc theo dõi phiếu bầu và giảm thiểu rủi ro sai sót trong quá trình xử lý, đồng thời cho biết những thay đổi này sẽ cung cấp cho các quan chức bầu cử những công cụ tốt hơn để xác nhận rằng phiếu bầu được nhận và kiểm đếm một cách chính xác.

segments.src: ## Why a Federal Judge Intervened
segments.tr: ## Tại sao một thẩm phán liên bang lại can thiệp

segments.src: A federal judge blocked the rules from taking effect just weeks before voters head to the polls, citing concerns raised by voting rights advocates and several state election offices that the abrupt changes could cause widespread confusion.
segments.tr: Một thẩm phán liên bang đã ngăn chặn các quy định này có hiệu lực chỉ vài tuần trước khi cử tri đi bỏ phiếu, dẫn ra những lo ngại từ các nhà bảo vệ quyền bỏ phiếu và một số văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang rằng những thay đổi đột ngột có thể gây ra sự bối rối trên diện rộng.

segments.src: Court documents indicate the judge warned that implementing unfamiliar barcode and verification requirements so close to an election could result in valid ballots being delayed, flagged, or rejected — effectively disenfranchising voters who had no opportunity to adjust to the new process.
segments.tr: Các tài liệu của tòa án cho thấy thẩm phán đã cảnh báo rằng việc áp dụng các yêu cầu xác minh và mã vạch xa lạ quá gần ngày bầu cử có thể dẫn đến việc các phiếu bầu hợp lệ bị trì hoãn, bị đánh dấu nghi vấn hoặc bị từ chối — tước đi quyền bỏ phiếu của những cử tri không có cơ hội thích ứng với quy trình mới một cách hiệu quả.

segments.src: Attorneys representing challengers to the rules have said that election administrators in multiple states were not given adequate time to update systems, train poll workers, or notify voters, arguing that any changes of this scale should typically be phased in well before an election cycle begins, not in the final weeks before it.
segments.tr: Các luật sư đại diện cho những người phản đối quy định cho biết các nhà quản lý bầu cử ở nhiều tiểu bang đã không được cung cấp đủ thời gian để cập nhật hệ thống, đào tạo nhân viên phòng phiếu hoặc thông báo cho cử tri, đồng thời lập luận rằng bất kỳ thay đổi nào ở quy mô này thường phải được thực hiện dần dần trước khi chu kỳ bầu cử bắt đầu, chứ không phải trong những tuần cuối cùng trước đó.

segments.src: ## The Path to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Con đường đến Tối cao Pháp viện

segments.src: Since the injunction was issued, the administration's legal team has pursued an unusually rapid appeals strategy, returning to the Supreme Court on an emergency basis for a third time to request a stay of the lower court's order.
segments.tr: Kể từ khi lệnh đình chỉ được ban hành, đội ngũ pháp lý của chính quyền đã theo đuổi một chiến lược kháng cáo nhanh chóng bất thường, quay trở lại Tối cao Pháp viện theo thủ tục khẩn cấp lần thứ ba để yêu cầu tạm dừng phán quyết của tòa án cấp dưới.

segments.src: In its filings, the administration has argued that USPS and state election officials can implement the requirements on short notice and that delaying the rules could undermine confidence in ballot processing during a high-turnout midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Trong các hồ sơ của mình, chính quyền lập luận rằng USPS và các quan chức bầu cử tiểu bang có thể thực hiện các yêu cầu này trong thời gian ngắn và việc trì hoãn các quy định có thể làm giảm lòng tin vào quá trình xử lý phiếu bầu trong một chu kỳ bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ có tỷ lệ cử tri đi bỏ phiếu cao.

segments.src: Opponents counter that the repeated emergency appeals themselves reflect the risk of last-minute disruption, and that the Court should allow the more deliberate lower-court review process to continue rather than greenlighting changes on an emergency docket with limited briefing.
segments.tr: Những người phản đối phản bác rằng chính các kháng cáo khẩn cấp lặp đi lặp lại đã phản ánh rủi ro gây gián đoạn vào phút chót, và Tòa án nên cho phép quy trình xem xét kỹ lưỡng hơn của tòa án cấp dưới được tiếp tục thay vì bật đèn xanh cho những thay đổi trên một hồ sơ khẩn cấp với các bản tóm tắt pháp lý hạn chế.

segments.src: The Supreme Court has not yet indicated when it will rule on the latest request.
segments.tr: Tối cao Pháp viện vẫn chưa cho biết khi nào họ sẽ đưa ra phán quyết về yêu cầu mới nhất này.

segments.src: Legal analysts note that the justices could act quickly given the approaching election calendar, though the outcome — and its practical effect on ballots already in the mail-in process in several states — remains uncertain.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích pháp lý lưu ý rằng các thẩm phán có thể hành động nhanh chóng do lịch trình bầu cử đang cận kề, mặc dù kết quả — và tác động thực tế của nó đối với các phiếu bầu đã được gửi qua thư ở một số tiểu bang — vẫn chưa chắc chắn.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: Election officials in several states have said they are preparing contingency plans for either outcome, while voting rights groups continue to monitor the litigation closely.
segments.tr: Các quan chức bầu cử ở một số tiểu bang cho biết họ đang chuẩn bị các kế hoạch dự phòng cho cả hai kết quả, trong khi các nhóm bảo vệ quyền bỏ phiếu tiếp tục theo dõi sát sao vụ kiện tụng.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, the case is expected to remain a focal point for both election administrators and voters relying on mail-in ballots in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: Với việc cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ đang đến gần, vụ việc dự kiến sẽ tiếp tục là tâm điểm chú ý của cả các nhà quản lý bầu cử và cử tri phụ thuộc vào phiếu bầu qua thư trong những tuần tới.
